admission.justification: The admitted proof must assert the four owner index values at the comparison after tree and a readable entries answer when those queries fail, guarding false after-tree facts.

applicability: The card-entry tree read for a four-tree review comparison.
conditions: Use the after entry path, or before entry path when the after entry is absent, as the after-side located path.
Count distinct realized invariants at that path, incoming links of the entry invariant, whether that live invariant lacks proof, and open weaknesses at that path.
Compute facts in the same index open that lists after entries, memoizing each path and invariant within the read.
No after index or a failed facts read yields entry_memory unavailable with the bound tree and reason; it does not turn the card read itself into a failed entries read.
exclusions: Reading the current checkout index in place of the bound after tree.
Inventing zero for a failed or absent measurement.
Treating weakness count at a path as a per-entry weakness count.

Browser card-answer retention and retry have a separate policy; recorded-serving reuse remains owned by INV-YTPBCF. This invariant supplies the four bound index values and honest unavailable state only.
